newsitem.title: CHINA: China farm bank loans at 631.79 bln at end-March.
newsitem.headline: China farm bank loans at 631.79 bln at end-March.

text.p: The China Agricultural Development Bank had extended total loans of 631.791 billion yuan ($76.11 billion) at the end of March this year, the Financial News said on Monday.
That marked an increase of 373.191 billion yuan more compared with loans at end-June 1994, the newspaper said.
At the end of 1996, the amount of loans extended for the purchase of agricultural by-products was 536.625 billion yuan, or 85.8 percent of total loans.
The figure included 379.885 billion yuan to buy grain, cotton and edible oil, the newspaper said.

The bank, set up in April 1994, had extended loans worth 24.345 billion yuan to China's poverty alleviation programme by end-1996, or up 13.846 billion yuan compared with its start of business in 1994, the newspaper said.
The Agricultural Development Bank now accounts for more than 50 percent of all national credit funds for poverty alleviation, it said.

The bank has branches and business departments in 30 provinces, sub-branches in 299 districts and cities, secondary-level business offices in 264 districts and cities, county branches in 1,625 counties and total staff of 47,000, it said.
